items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I played with Charlie a lot, the late Charlie Shavers

ctx.x: If I can bring his memory back to the Basin Street East, perhaps we can have a conversation. I played with Charlie a lot, the late Charlie Shavers, and he and Charlie Shavers were very great friends, I understand.
One thing we haven't talked about... You have a really extensive repertoire, haven't you.
